Chicken Pakora
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 3:56pm

Ingredients




16 smalls Chunks of chicken breast
1 lrg Onion
Approx same size piece of ginger
1 Clove garlic
1 Chopped jalapeno pepper (if You want it spicy)
1 teaspoon Lemon juice OR
2 teaspoons Plan yogurt
cup Dry batter
1 teaspoon Salt

Preparation

1 Blend everything but chicken and batter in blender until fine. Use this to marinate the chicken for 1 hr. Mix water with batter until batter is think as honey. Put chicken in batter. Fry pieces under low heat to a medium brown. Enjoy it as an appetizer or snack. 2 Serves 4-6. 3 9
